item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】WAV - Rochelle "Praying For An Angel" US CD Maxi
item.description:
​

after the surprise success of collage's "I'll be loving you" in early 1994, freestyle music was having a kind of resurgance at US radio. bay area artists jocelyn enriquez and buffy saw their debut singles both chart on billboard's hot 100. chicago's own rochelle, a teen puerto rican saw her debut single garner a decent amount of buzz in the midwest. "praying for an angel," missed the hot 100 but reached #32 on billboard's hot dance/maxi singles sale chart in january 1995.

i got into freestyle music in 1995 much later after it's commercial peak in the late 80s. "praying for angel" was one of the songs that pulled me in deeper. i remember walking past a car equipment shop in north and hearing this song blasting from the store's speakers. i immediately stopped in my tracks to listen to the song. i would then purchase the cassette maxi-single about a week later.
